int_name: N BROAD ST & W FISHER AVE

result.summary: This residential intersection features a four-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking in the asphalt surface near the crosswalk could present a tripping hazard.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and signalization. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Faded pavement markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and lane markings are showing signs of wear, reducing their visibility to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Road surface at the foreground crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility continental patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and signalized traffic control, including a 'No Turn on Red' restriction. However, the environment lacks a pedestrian refuge island and visible pedestrian-specific signal heads, leaving pedestrians exposed across multiple travel lanes.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island for protection.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide clear crossing intervals.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk that is significantly faded. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the presence of parked cars near the crossing reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: There are no visible pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk
